title: Trump Ocean short
hook: Trump wants an OCEAN named after himself?!

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: President Trump just floated renaming an *entire ocean*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: At a rally in Tennessee, he said the Atlantic or the Pacific could become the *Trump Ocean*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Or, as another option, the *Ocean of the Americas*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: The crowd cheered. Several outlets called it a joke, and he didn't say *which ocean*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: And it's not his first rename. First, the Gulf of Mexico became the *Gulf of America*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Then in August, Lake Ontario became *Lake America*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: In his words: we have a gulf, we have a lake. *Now all we need is an ocean.*

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Google Maps already shows *Lake America* to users in the U.S.

scenes.name: Tim Houston
scenes.quote: Real foolishness now. It's Lake Ontario, buddy.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Canada fired back. Nova Scotia's premier wrote: *It's Lake Ontario, buddy.*

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: And Prime Minister Mark Carney says Canadians will keep the *400 year old* name.

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: So could an ocean really be next? And why can't one country rename it?

lines.speaker: Anchor
lines.text: Watch the *full story* on our channel.
